name: Declared Native Refined-Scalar Bundle Production (native-refined-attempt)
description: C02/C10 produce demo: the declared `native-attempt` route builds a bundle from a module that declares a refined scalar alias (`type Port = i64 where v >= 1 && v <= 65535;`) — the record pins the v2 member profile and the refined source profile; `native-check` re-derives under the same gate; a typedef whose base does not resolve is refused.

intro: Step 1: Request the refined-scalar bundle profile.
Step 2: Recheck the declared bundle fields.
Step 3: Try an unresolved typedef base.
narrative.before: The declared route boundary has not yet been checked.
narrative.after: Only the route's declared fields are checked; broader guarantees are not claimed.
narrative.moment: Refined scalar profile only; unresolved typedef base fails closed.

result_message: Result: Refined profile only; invalid typedef base fails.

intent_fidelity.source_intent: Show the v2 member profile end to end: `native-attempt` produces a bundle whose record names mumei.native-pure-i64-module-linux-x86_64/v2 with source_profile mumei.pure-i64-refined-scalar/v1, `native-check` rechecks it consistent under that same gate, and a typedef with an unresolvable base selects nothing.
success_criteria: report.json carries schema mumei.native-attempt-report/v1 with build_id equal to sha256(native-bundle.json) and a non-null selected_result
bundle/native-bundle.json pins profile mumei.native-pure-i64-module-linux-x86_64/v2 and source.source_profile mumei.pure-i64-refined-scalar/v1
native-check on the v2 bundle reports bundle_check consistent with discharged file_identity
bad_report.json carries no build_id, no selected_result and a nonzero normalized exit_code

harness_contract.intent: Demonstrate the refined scalar member profile end to end: run `python -m agent native-attempt` on a module declaring a refined scalar alias, assert the record pins the v2 member profile and refined source profile, recheck the bundle through `native-check`, then show a typedef with an unresolvable base produces no claimed build_id and no selection.
artifact_contracts: Read inputs: scenarios/native_refined_attempt/src/main.mm (typedef Port plus atoms using it in signatures) and bad.mm (typedef whose base name does not resolve).
Step 1 runs the declared `native-attempt` route and asserts report.build_id equals sha256(native-bundle.json), record profile v2, source_profile refined, and all five bundle members on disk.
Step 2 runs `native-check` on the produced bundle pinned to the reported build ID and asserts bundle_check consistent with discharged file_identity under the v2 gate.
Step 3 reruns `native-attempt` on the unresolvable-base source and asserts no build_id, no selection, and a nonzero normalized exit_code.
Generate evidence: attempt.log, check.log, bad.log, build_id.txt, report.json, check_report.json, bad_report.json, bundle/, harness_state.json, result.json, and report.md.
notes: The v2 member profile admits modules that declare refined scalar aliases (`type Name = <scalar> where <bool predicate over v>;`) in addition to the v1 pure-i64 fragment; the record pins the admitted profile by name so a recheck re-derives under the same gate.
The reported build_id is the Core-computed sha256 of native-bundle.json — the exact identity a native-check call pins via --expected-build-id.

bad.mm declares `type Counter = Missing where v > 0;` — the base name does not resolve to a declared scalar, so the whole module is out of profile rather than silently re-admitted under the narrower v1 gate.
Every step exits the pipe-and-grep form so a failed command cannot pass silently as exit-0 output.
budget_policy_fingerprint is native-refined-attempt-v1 for deterministic runs.

steps.name: Produce a v2-profile native bundle through native-attempt
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent native-attempt --core {mumei_bin} --source {root_dir}/scenarios/native_refined_attempt/src/main.mm --bundle {output_dir}/bundle --output {output_dir}/report.json > {output_dir}/attempt.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/report.json; cat {output_dir}/attempt.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json, hashlib; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/report.json')); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.native-attempt-report/v1', r['schema_version']; assert r['build_id']==hashlib.sha256(open('{output_dir}/bundle/native-bundle.json','rb').read()).hexdigest(); assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is not None; assert r['candidate']['schema_version']=='mumei.verifier-evidence-candidate/v1'; rec=json.load(open('{output_dir}/bundle/native-bundle.json')); assert rec['profile']=='mumei.native-pure-i64-module-linux-x86_64/v2', rec['profile']; assert rec['source']['source_profile']=='mumei.pure-i64-refined-scalar/v1', rec['source']; import os; [open('{output_dir}/bundle/'+n).close() for n in ('native-bundle.json','program.ll','program.o','proof-cert.json','program')]; open('{output_dir}/build_id.txt','w').write(r['build_id']); print('native-attempt produced v2 bundle, build_id verified'); print(rec['profile']); print(rec['source']['source_profile'])"
steps.artifact_contract: report.json holds mumei.native-attempt-report/v1 with build_id equal to sha256(native-bundle.json), a non-null selected_result and a candidate; the record pins the v2 member profile and refined source profile; bundle/ holds all five declared members.
steps.verifier_gate: native-attempt exits 0; build_id matches the Core-computed record digest, the record names the v2 profile, and the bundle directory is complete.

steps.name: native-check rechecks the v2 bundle consistent
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent native-check --core {mumei_bin} --bundle {output_dir}/bundle --source {root_dir}/scenarios/native_refined_attempt/src/main.mm --expected-build-id $(cat {output_dir}/build_id.txt) --output {output_dir}/check_report.json > {output_dir}/check.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/check_report.json; cat {output_dir}/check.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/check_report.json')); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.native-check-report/v1', r['schema_version']; assert r['bundle_check']=='consistent', r; assert r['discharged_checks']==['file_identity']; assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is not None; print('native-check on v2 bundle: consistent, file_identity discharged')"
steps.artifact_contract: check_report.json holds mumei.native-check-report/v1 with bundle_check consistent and discharged file_identity for the v2-profile bundle.
steps.verifier_gate: native-check exits 0; the v2-pinned identities re-derive under the same refined gate and check consistent.

steps.name: Typedef with unresolvable base produces no claimed build_id
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent native-attempt --core {mumei_bin} --source {root_dir}/scenarios/native_refined_attempt/src/bad.mm --bundle {output_dir}/bad_bundle --output {output_dir}/bad_report.json > {output_dir}/bad.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/bad_report.json; cat {output_dir}/bad.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/bad_report.json')); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.native-attempt-report/v1'; assert 'build_id' not in r; assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is None; assert 'candidate' not in r; assert r['normalized'].get('exit_code') not in (0, None), r['normalized']; print('unresolvable base: no claimed build_id, no selection')"
steps.artifact_contract: bad_report.json holds mumei.native-attempt-report/v1 with no build_id, no selected_result and a nonzero normalized exit_code.
steps.verifier_gate: native-attempt exits 0 with an unselected lineage; the unresolvable-base typedef is a run outcome, not a static error.
